# The definition of "required for merge" for vidra-user.
#
# scripts/ci/require-checks.sh reads this file in the `ci-required` job and
# fails unless every entry is satisfied for the commit under test. Configure
# ONE required status check in branch protection — `ci-required` — and this
# file becomes the single place the required set is declared and reviewed.
# TWIN: vidra-core and vidra-search carry the same file and the same job.
#
# Syntax (one check-run name per line, as GitHub reports it — matrix legs carry
# their leg in the name):
#   name    must EXIST for this commit and must conclude `success`
#   ?name   required only IF it ran (path-filtered lanes)
#
# Nothing but `success` passes: `cancelled`, `timed_out`, `neutral` and
# `skipped` all fail.

# frontend-ci.yml — the canonical `npm run ci` gate (typecheck, lint, icon lint,
# vitest, production build, mocked Playwright smoke) with the no-skip audit.
frontend

# contract-ci.yml — path contract + generated-type freshness against vidra-core's
# DEFAULT BRANCH. ORDERING RULE: a frontend PR consuming a new endpoint is red
# until the core PR that adds it has merged. That red is correct; land core
# first and re-run. Never drop this to unblock a merge — it is the only check
# that notices the client calling an endpoint the backend does not serve.
contract

# frontend-e2e-backed.yml — real vidra-core + Postgres, both storage backends.
# fail-fast is off so an S3-only regression neither masks nor is masked by a
# local-disk one; both legs are therefore required independently.
e2e-backed (local)
e2e-backed (s3)

# frontend-e2e-backed.yml — single-purpose lanes. Each runs one spec against a
# stack posture the main matrix cannot hold, and each is audited against an
# EMPTY skip allowlist: they are the only automated proof those flows have.
channel-sync-backed
ipfs-backed

# ci-guard.yml — action pins, no hidden continue-on-error, npm ci not npm
# install, frontend-ci really runs the canonical gate, and required-checks.txt
# names only jobs that exist. Path-filtered to .github/workflows/**.
?guard

# NOT required, deliberately:
#   quarantine-backed   frontend-e2e-optional.yml — scheduled/dispatch only,
#                       because its instance flag contradicts the main matrix
#   publish             release-triggered image build, not a PR gate
